title: Coastal Magic of Phuket and Krabi
alt: Turquoise shallows and limestone islands off the Krabi coast in Thailand
transport: Private sedan transfers with speedboat island crossings

expert.name: Ananya Iyer
expert.quote: Three nights in each place, so you unpack twice in a week. Two island days and one rainforest day in between.
expert.tip: Do the Emerald Pool early because the water is clearest before the crowds. The Tiger Cave climb is over twelve hundred steps, so carry water and go before the heat builds.

summary: Seven days on the Andaman coast with three nights in Phuket and three in Ao Nang. A speedboat day at Phi Phi, a tiger encounter, the Krabi 4 Islands by boat and a rainforest day at the Emerald Pool and Tiger Cave temple.
included: Included: 6 nights in 2 four star hotels with daily breakfast; Phi Phi islands speedboat tour with lunch; Tiger Kingdom big tiger encounter with private transfers; Krabi 4 Islands speedboat tour with a lunch box; Emerald Pool and Tiger Cave temple tour; 13 airport, pier and sightseeing transfers.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; park and temple entry fees; meals other than those listed; personal expenses.

day_titles.3: Tiger Kingdom and a free afternoon
day_titles.6: Emerald Pool and Tiger Cave temple

1: Arrival at Phuket International Airport and private sedan transfer to your hotel
Check in at The Marina Phuket and keep the first day free
Optional: Wat Chalong, sunset at Promthep Cape or Old Phuket Town
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer down to the Phuket pier
Speedboat transfer out to the Phi Phi group for the whole day
Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Loh Samah Bay and Monkey Beach, with lunch
Return speedboat and shared transfer to your hotel
3: Breakfast, then private transfer out to Tiger Kingdom
Big tiger encounter with the keepers alongside you throughout
Back by early afternoon with the rest of the day free
Optional: the Phuket Aquarium at Cape Panwa or the Tha Rua shrine
4: Breakfast, check out and private sedan transfer by road to Krabi
Check in at Krabi Resort on the Ao Nang beachfront
Afternoon free on the sand or along the beach road
Optional: Wat Kaew Korawaram in town or an elephant sanctuary inland
5: Breakfast, then shared transfer to the Ao Nang pier
Speedboat transfer out to Koh Poda, Tup island and Chicken island
Snorkel the shallows and stop at Phra Nang beach, lunch box on board
Return shared transfer to the resort in the afternoon
6: Breakfast, then shared transfer inland for the rainforest day
Swim in the Emerald Pool inside Thung Teao forest park
Climb to Tiger Cave temple for the long view across the Krabi plain
Back at the resort by evening
7: Breakfast and an unhurried check out
Private sedan transfer to Krabi airport for your trip home

stops.name: Phuket

program.name: Islands, tigers and slow evenings
program.description: Three nights in Phuket with a full day at Phi Phi, a tiger encounter and an afternoon left open for the viewpoints.

activities.name: Phi Phi Islands by Speedboat
activities.description: A full day across the Phi Phi group with Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Loh Samah Bay and Monkey Beach, and lunch on the tour.

activities.name: Tiger Kingdom Phuket
activities.description: Time inside the enclosure with the big tigers, keepers beside you throughout, with private transfers each way.

activities.name: Sunset at Promthep Cape
activities.description: The southern tip of Phuket, where the headland drops into the sea and the sunset draws a crowd every evening.

activities.name: Old Phuket Town
activities.description: Painted Sino Portuguese shophouses, coffee roasters and small galleries along Thalang and Dibuk roads.

stops.name: Krabi
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast included · Super Deluxe room · 4★ · Krabi Resort on the Ao Nang beachfront

program.name: Ao Nang, the islands and the rainforest
program.description: Three nights in Ao Nang with a speedboat tour of the 4 Islands and a day inland at the Emerald Pool and Tiger Cave temple.

activities.name: Krabi 4 Islands by Speedboat
activities.description: A speedboat day across Koh Poda, Tup island and Chicken island, with snorkelling, Phra Nang beach and a lunch box on board.

activities.name: Emerald Pool and Tiger Cave Temple
activities.description: A spring fed pool inside Thung Teao forest park, then the climb up Wat Tham Suea for the view across the Krabi plain.

activities.name: Krabi Elephant Sanctuary
activities.description: A no riding sanctuary inland from Ao Nang where you feed and walk with rescued elephants alongside their keepers.

activities.name: Wat Kaew Korawaram
activities.description: A white temple on a rise in Krabi town, reached by a long flight of steps and quiet in the late afternoon.
